title: helichrysum aureum
intro: Helichrysum aureum, commonly known as the yellow-flowered Everlasting, is a perennial plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum aureum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Helichrysum aureum have also been reported to possess anti-diabetic and anti-hypertensive effects, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and modern pharmaceutical research.
